one_line: Google's AI-powered notebook that answers questions and generates summaries/notes grounded in your uploaded documents.
auth_notes: NotebookLM has no public API. Google's public AI developer surface is the separate Gemini API (different product); NotebookLM itself exposes no documented auth, endpoints, or developer program.
self_serve_notes: The product is free to use, but there is no API or developer credential issuance for NotebookLM — nothing to self-serve against.

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP. Only unofficial/community servers exist, typically wrapping Google's Gemini API or reverse-engineered NotebookLM internals (fragile).
